Eli (PM): dropping a quick prototype for a compact 'seat' invite drawer and a small 'Activity' quick-jump in the roles list. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-seatflow 

Eli (PM): two asks: 1) for orgs with enforced SSO, should the email invite input be removed entirely? 2) how do we make the Activity quick-jump keyboard friendly (skip links / anchors)?

Nora (Designer): i'd remove the email input for sso_enforced orgs and show a small inline card: 'Invites via org SSO' + primary CTA 'Copy join link' + link 'Manage provisioning'. keep the drawer compact. Add a small 'Expires' hint under the CTA.

Nora (Designer): Activity quick-jump: add a tiny button next to role name (icon only on desktop, label on mobile) that scrolls to audit. make it a real button with aria-label and focus styles.

Owen (Frontend): agree on removing input when org.sso_enforced=true. implementation note: when replacing the input, announce with aria-live="polite" and also programmatically move focus to the primary CTA after drawer opens so keyboard users aren't lost. snippet: 
const card = document.getElementById('sso-invite-card');
card?.setAttribute('role','region');
card?.setAttribute('aria-label','Invite method');
const cta = card.querySelector('button');
cta?.focus();

Owen (Frontend): for activity jump: use stable anchor ids like `audit-role-<id>`. When user clicks Activity: 
1) ensure audit list is loaded, 2) scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'}), 3) set tabindex='-1' on anchor and call focus(). fallback: open audit page in new tab if offline.

Priya (Backend): backend will add `POST /orgs/:id/invite-link` returning { token, expires_at }. if expiry not supported initially, expires_at=null. we'll also emit audit records with `anchor_id` and `role_id`.

Sam (A11y): important accessibility points: 
- when email input is removed, announce the change via aria-live and ensure focus isn't lost. 
- Activity button must be in logical tab order after the role name. use aria-controls to reference the audit region. 
- anchors must be focusable and receive focus after scroll; use `tabindex='-1'` then remove it after a short delay or when focus leaves. 
- color contrast: ensure the sso card text meets 4.5:1.

Sam (A11y): suggested microcopy: "Invites are managed by your organization's Single Sign-On. Share this join link with members managed by your identity provider."

deploy-bot: telemetry reminder: emit `invite.method` (email|link|idp), `invite.link.copied`, `audit.jump.source=roles_list` and include `role_id` as a dimension.

Eli (PM): nice. action items: Nora -> update compact comps + mobile icon label; Owen -> aria-live + focus flow + Activity scroll logic; Priya -> API contract + audit anchor fields; Sam -> final a11y checklist. i'll file tickets and tag owners. thanks! :rocket:
